main_text.head: EPISTOLA
main_text.p: nominatim ad Reginam Sueciae, item ad Brandenburgiae Principem legationibus defunctus: jam à tribus circiter lustris, præmaturâ morte, cum ageret annum ætatis quinquagesimum secundum, mortalibus ereptus, magno Reipublicæ & bonorum omnium luctu: Cujus ut virtutum, ita & divini symboli hæres es: symbolus autem ejus erat, Animum rege: quo velut compendio vir optimus, & in omnibus vitæ partibus moderatus, omnes

page.notes: The running text is set in a clear roman face with a few italic words. The right edge shows show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. The last line "omnes" is set flush right and ends the visible text; the page continues below only in blank space.
